verdict.rationale: Babylon.js ships official, first-party npm packages for all modules ([babylonjs-docs-24], [babylonjs-docs-1]) as tree-shakable ES6 modules with TypeScript typings and full IntelliSense ([babylonjs-docs-12], [babylonjs-docs-25]). A runtime probe confirms @babylonjs/core 9.26.1 is published on npm under Apache-2.0 with about 234K weekly downloads ([babylonjs-probe-rt-1]), and a community user reports the TypeScript integration works well ([babylonjs-comm-15]). missing for 10: official SDKs beyond JavaScript/TypeScript are only implied (Babylon Native is mentioned without SDK detail), and the evidence contains no in-depth first-party SDK reference beyond llms.txt summary lines.
